title: SailPoint IdentityIQ® 9.0: A modern foundation for the world's most complex enterprises
summary: Discover SailPoint IdentityIQ® 9.0: A modernized, secure on-premises foundation built to reduce governance burden, sharpen access control, and simplify upgrades.
body_markdown:
**Date:** October 6, 2026


**Reading time:** 5 minutes


Some of the world's most significant organizations run their identity programs on SailPoint IdentityIQ. They rely on it to solve governance challenges that are unique to their business — deeply customized, highly regulated, and often bound by strict data residency requirements. For these enterprises, on-premises identity governance isn't a legacy choice. It's a deliberate one.


That's why we built IdentityIQ 9.0. Announced at Navigate 2026, this release modernizes the core of our on-premises identity governance solution and delivers on a promise we've made to every customer: to bring you along on your modernization journey, without asking you to trade away the control your enterprise depends on.


This is more than a routine update. It's a significant, forward-looking investment in the platform — and in the customers who have built their identity programs on it.


## **Meeting complexity with a modern foundation**


The reality of the modern enterprise is complex and hybrid. Systems span data centers and clouds. Regulations vary by region. And identity programs, refined over years, carry deep customization that reflects how each business actually operates.


IdentityIQ 9.0 rebuilds the platform's technical foundation on current enterprise standards, replacing components that had been in place since the platform's earliest days. The practical benefit is clear: IdentityIQ now runs on modern, secure enterprise application platforms. That means your organization can keep its infrastructure current instead of holding it back to stay compatible.


Just as important, this modernized foundation gives SailPoint a maintainable, secure base to keep building on. It signals continued investment and a longer runway for the enterprises that run identity governance on premises. When your platform's foundation is current and supportable, you protect your investment for years to come — and you position your identity program to scale with your ambitions rather than work around their limits.


As SailPoint leadership shared at Navigate: "Our goal is to meet our customers where they are and provide them with a clear path forward. We've rebuilt the platform's foundation on current enterprise standards, making it more efficient, easier to maintain, and ready to carry our customers into the future."


## **Reducing the daily burden of governance**


Strong governance shouldn't come at the cost of the people who manage it every day. Reviewers who reconfigure the same screen at every login, administrators who search and come up empty, and teams buried in repetitive certification tasks — these frictions add up. They slow certifications, frustrate business users, and quietly erode program effectiveness.


IdentityIQ 9.0 takes that burden seriously. A refreshed, streamlined experience makes everyday work faster for administrators and business users alike. Access reviews are smoother and easier to navigate, with preferences that persist across sessions, so reviewers stop rebuilding the same view. Search is more forgiving and more accurate, returning complete results the first time. And the application configuration experience has been redesigned for the business administrators who now handle this work — not just technical specialists.


The value here is measured in outcomes. When reviewer fatigue drops, certifications move faster. When administrators find what they need without guesswork, audits get easier. And when the tools reflect how people actually work, governance becomes something your teams can sustain, not just survive.


## **Sharpening control and moving toward least privilege**


For senior security leaders, the ultimate measure of any identity platform is how well it enforces the right access — no more, no less. IdentityIQ 9.0 strengthens that control in ways that matter most for your most sensitive systems.


Granular, time-based access lets you grant and approve access with precise start and end times, complete with time zone support and enforcement across roles and entitlements. For privileged access on critical systems, this is a meaningful step toward least privilege. Access exists only when it's needed, and it expires when it should — closing the standing-access gaps that create risk.


The release also shifts the responsibility for keeping governance data accurate to the people who understand it best. Instead of central administrators wrestling to maintain ownership records and entitlement descriptions, an automated, self-service process puts periodic review in the hands of the actual business owners. The result is better data quality, cleaner audits, and access decisions grounded in real context — all while saving your team time.


Alongside these controls, a standardized configuration approach makes your custom forms, business logic, and interface scripts easier to maintain and carry forward. That means less technical debt and a simpler path through future upgrades.


## **A supported path forward**


We know that modernization only matters if you can get there. That's why IdentityIQ 9.0 ships with tooling that automates much of the upgrade work — scanning your environment, identifying what needs updating, and handling the majority of changes automatically. You can assess your readiness on your own timeline, well before you commit.


The foundation has been rebuilt. Now it's your turn to build on it.


Connect with your SailPoint Customer Success team to explore what IdentityIQ 9.0 means for your identity program and how to plan your upgrade with confidence.
